description: Start an appointment request that Xona emails to the selected clinic, without leaving the conversation. Xona first emails the patient a code that confirms their address; confirm_dental_request then sends the request. Use it where list_dental_practice_actions marks xona_email_appointment_request as completes_in_conversation.

patient_email.description: The patient's own email; the code goes there

patient_name.description: The patient's name as they typed it

name: start_dental_request
title: Start a dental appointment request
